title: Generate Color Palettes in Python

steps.title: Step 1: Setup
steps.explanation: We start by importing the colorsys and random modules, and define a function to generate a palette.

steps.title: Step 2: Convert Color
code_lines: h, s, v = colorsys.rgb_to_hsv(*tuple(int(c)/255 for c in base_color))
steps.explanation: We convert the base color from RGB to HSV to make it easier to generate related colors.

steps.title: Step 3: Generate Palette
steps.explanation: We loop through to generate 5 related colors by adjusting the hue slightly each time.

steps.title: Step 4: Use It!
steps.explanation: We generate a random base color and print out the resulting color palette.
